title: Exploring possibilities towards PeRsonalIsed MEdicine in Rheumatoid Arthritis (PRIMERA): tailored modifications to standard treat-to-target management—a multicentre, randomised, open-label trial
observations_or_assays: Low disease activity under the source-defined DAS threshold
time_scope: ts/bDMARD use at month 10; the reported overall 10-month DAS analysis; LDA at month 3.
excluded: Separate visit-by-visit DAS rows, time-to-LDA, remission and autoantibody subgroups
Per-protocol analyses, other medication timelines, PROs and safety
population_or_material: The main randomized-analysis population of DMARD-naïve RA in PRIMERA.
requested_items: Ten-month ts/bDMARD use counts/proportions and published difference; overall ten-month longitudinal DAS Wald test; month-three LDA counts/proportions and difference. Exclude per-visit DAS and other LDA times.
